title: DestinyOS: BaZi & Tarot
subtitle: Offline charts, tarot & stars
description:
Read your sky. Know your path.

DestinyOS brings eight traditions together: BaZi (Four Pillars), Zi Wei Dou Shu, I Ching with Mei Hua and Liu Yao, Qi Men Dun Jia, tarot, Western astrology, Vedic astrology, and numerology. Explore their charts and meanings in a native app built for cultural learning and self-reflection.

Understand the reading
• Offline charts and core readings come from deterministic rules and a structured knowledge library, rather than AI-generated predictions at runtime.
• Zoom into charts, tap for details, and read the reasoning. Reports identify calculation schools and explain the limits of an unknown birth time.
• Switch between English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.

Made for your phone
• Shuffle, cut, choose, and turn tarot cards with touch gestures and haptic feedback.
• Shake your phone to cast Liu Yao coins, or use the button instead.
• Explore a sky based on a real star catalog, daily forecasts, a forecast calendar, and a reflection journal.
• Local reminders and home-screen widgets keep your daily overview close.

Offline and in your control
• Local charts and core readings work offline, without an account.
• Profiles, readings, and journals are encrypted on your device. Sign in if you want to sync. Birth details are never used for advertising tracking.
• Sign-in, sync, purchases, share links, PDF export, and Ask the Master require a connection.
• Ask the Master is a separate, optional AI feature with an AI label and an in-app reporting option.
• Delete your account and its data inside the app.

All systems and local features are free. The free version shows ads within the daily overview and between report chapters. Pro removes ads without locking chart content: US$2.99 per month or US$6.99 for lifetime ad removal, with local prices shown by your store. Monthly subscriptions renew automatically and can be managed in your system subscription settings. Restore purchases in the app. Sign in to the same account to sync ad-free access between the app and website.

For entertainment, cultural learning, and self-reflection only. No medical, psychological, legal, financial, or investment advice; no guaranteed outcomes. Intended for adults aged 18 and over.
